lines.text: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer;
give ear, O God of Jacob.
Take notice of our shield, O God,
and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.
For better is one day in Your courts
I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God
than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield;
the LORD gives grace and glory;
from those who walk with integrity.
how blessed is the man who trusts in You!

pictures.scene: Jan van der Heyden, Two Churches and a Town Wall — the path climbing past the wall to the churches, until each appears before God in Zion, O LORD God of Hosts hear my prayer
pictures.name: pd_heyden_twee_kerken

pictures.scene: Mikhail Nesterov, Vision to the Youth Bartholomew — the boy standing with his hands folded before the haloed elder, give ear O God of Jacob
pictures.name: pd_nesterov_varfolomey

pictures.scene: Edmund Blair Leighton, The Accolade — the kneeling man given the sword on his shoulder with the shield standing by, take notice of our shield O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed
pictures.name: pd_leighton_accolade

pictures.scene: Vilhelm Hammershøi, Interior in Strandgade with Sunlight on the Floor — the quiet room with nothing in it but the window the door and the sun lying on the floor, for better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere
pictures.name: pd_hammershoi_solskin

pictures.scene: Christen Købke, The Northern Drawbridge to the Citadel in Copenhagen — the man standing at the gate of the bridge where the people pass through, I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked
pictures.name: pd_kobke_kastelsbro

pictures.scene: Jasper Francis Cropsey, Sunset after a Storm in the Catskill Mountains — the sun breaking out golden over the ridge once the storm has passed, for the LORD God is a sun and a shield, the LORD gives grace and glory
pictures.name: pd_cropsey_catskill

pictures.scene: Abraham Mignon, Stilleven met vruchten en een puttertje — the table heaped over with grapes and peaches and corn, He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity
pictures.name: pd_mignon_vruchten

pictures.scene: Harriet Backer, Blue Interior — the woman sitting at rest with her sewing in the blue evening room, O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You
pictures.name: pd_backer_blatt_interior
